sourceDate.text: 於是穰侯言於秦昭王伐齊，而呂禮亡

units.zh: 穰侯魏冉者，秦昭王母宣太后弟也。
units.en: Wei Ran, Marquis of Rang, was the younger brother of Empress Dowager Xuan, the mother of King Zhao of Qin.
units.literal: Wei Ran, Marquis of Rang, was the younger brother of Empress Dowager Xuan, mother of King Zhao of Qin.

units.zh: 其先楚人，姓羋氏。
units.en: His forebears were Chu people of the Mi clan.
units.literal: His ancestors were Chu people of the Mi clan.

units.zh: 秦武王卒，無子，立其弟為昭王。
units.en: When King Wu of Qin died without heirs, his younger brother ascended as King Zhao.
units.literal: When King Wu of Qin died without sons, his younger brother was established as King Zhao.

units.zh: 昭王母故號為羋八子，及昭王即位，羋八子號為宣太后。
units.en: King Zhao's mother was formerly known as Lady Mi the Eighth. When King Zhao ascended the throne, Lady Mi the Eighth was elevated to Empress Dowager Xuan.
units.literal: King Zhao's mother was formerly titled Lady Mi the Eighth. When King Zhao ascended the throne, Lady Mi the Eighth was honored as Empress Dowager Xuan.

units.zh: 宣太后非武王母。
units.en: Empress Dowager Xuan was not the mother of King Wu.
units.literal: Empress Dowager Xuan was not King Wu's mother.

units.zh: 武王母號曰惠文后，先武王死。
units.en: King Wu's mother was honored as Empress Huiwen and predeceased him.
units.literal: King Wu's mother was honored as Empress Huiwen and passed away before King Wu.

units.zh: 宣太后二弟：其異父長弟曰穰侯，姓魏氏，名冉；
units.en: Empress Dowager Xuan had two younger brothers: her elder half-brother from a different father was called Marquis of Rang, surnamed Wei, named Ran;
units.literal: Xuan Empress Dowager two younger brothers: different father elder brother called Marquis of Rang, surname Wei clan, named Ran;

units.zh: 同父弟曰羋戎，為華陽君。
units.en: Her younger uterine brother was Mi Rong, who became Lord of Huayang.
units.literal: her younger full brother was Mi Rong, who served as Lord of Huayang.

units.zh: 而昭王同母弟曰高陵君、涇陽君。
units.en: King Zhao's uterine younger brothers were titled Lord of Gaoling and Lord of Jingyang.
units.literal: King Zhao's full younger brothers were titled Lord of Gaoling and Lord of Jingyang.

units.zh: 而魏冉最賢，自惠王、武王時任職用事。
units.en: Wei Ran was the most capable among them. He held office and conducted affairs since the reigns of King Hui and King Wu.
units.literal: Wei Ran was the most capable of them. He held office and managed affairs from the time of King Hui and King Wu onward.

units.zh: 武王卒，諸弟爭立，唯魏冉力為能立昭王。
units.en: When King Wu died, his younger brothers vied for the throne. Only Wei Ran wielded sufficient power to establish King Zhao.
units.literal: When King Wu died, his younger brothers contended for the throne. Only Wei Ran exerted his strength to establish King Zhao.

units.zh: 昭王即位，以冉為將軍，衛咸陽。
units.en: When King Zhao ascended the throne, he appointed Ran as general to defend Xianyang.
units.literal: When King Zhao ascended the throne, he appointed Ran as general to guard Xianyang.

units.zh: 誅季君之亂，而逐武王后出之魏，昭王諸兄弟不善者皆滅之，威振秦國。
units.en: He executed Ji Jun's rebellion, banished King Wu's empress to Wei, and eliminated all of King Zhao's disloyal brothers. His authority shook the state of Qin.
units.literal: He executed the rebellion of Ji Jun, expelled King Wu's empress to Wei, and exterminated all of King Zhao's disloyal brothers. His might shook the state of Qin.

units.zh: 昭王少，宣太后自治，任魏冉為政。
units.en: Since King Zhao was young, Empress Dowager Xuan ruled personally and entrusted Wei Ran with conducting political affairs.
units.literal: Since King Zhao was young, Empress Dowager Xuan governed personally and employed Wei Ran to conduct political affairs.

units.zh: 昭王七年，樗里子死，而使涇陽君質於齊。
units.en: In the seventh year of King Zhao, Shu Lizi died, and Lord Jingyang was dispatched as hostage to Qi.
units.literal: In King Zhao's seventh year, Shu Lizi died, and Lord Jingyang was sent as hostage to Qi.

units.zh: 趙人樓緩來相秦，趙不利，乃使仇液之秦，請以魏冉為秦相。
units.en: The Zhao man Lou Huan came to serve as chancellor of Qin. This disadvantaged Zhao, so they dispatched Qiu Ye to Qin to petition for Wei Ran to become chancellor of Qin.
units.literal: The Zhao man Lou Huan came to serve as chancellor of Qin. This disadvantaged Zhao, so they sent Qiu Ye to Qin to request that Wei Ran be made chancellor of Qin.

units.zh: 仇液將行，其客宋公謂液曰：「秦不聽公，樓緩必怨公。
units.en: As Qiu Ye was about to depart, his guest Song Gong advised him, "If Qin does not listen to you, Lou Huan will certainly resent you.
units.literal: Qiu Ye about go, his guest Song Gong told Ye: Qin not listen jun, Lou Huan certainly resent jun.

units.zh: 公不若謂樓緩曰『請為公毋急秦』。
units.en: You should tell Lou Huan, 'Please do not hurry Qin on my behalf.'
units.literal: Jun not as tell Lou Huan: 'please for jun not hurry Qin.'

units.zh: 秦王見趙請相魏冉之不急，且不聽公。
units.en: The King of Qin will see that Zhao's petition to appoint Wei Ran as chancellor is not pressing and will not heed you.
units.literal: The King of Qin will see that Zhao's request to appoint Wei Ran as chancellor is not urgent and will not listen to you.

units.zh: 公言而事不成，以德樓子；
units.en: If you speak up and the plan fails, Lou Huan will feel indebted to you;
units.literal: If you speak and the matter does not succeed, Lou Huan will be grateful to you;

units.zh: 事成，魏冉故德公矣。」
units.en: When affairs succeed, Wei Ran will owe you a debt of gratitude."
units.literal: When affairs are complete, Wei Ran originally had merit in you."

units.zh: 於是仇液從之。
units.en: Then Qiu Ye complied.
units.literal: Then Qiu Ye went along with the plan.

units.zh: 而秦果免樓緩而魏冉相秦。
units.en: Qin did in fact remove Lou Huan and make Wei Ran its chancellor.
units.literal: Qin indeed dismissed Lou Huan and appointed Wei Ran as chancellor of Qin.

units.zh: 欲誅呂禮，禮出奔齊。
units.en: He sought to execute Lu Li, but Li fled to Qi.
units.literal: He wished to execute Lu Li, but Li fled to Qi.

units.zh: 昭王十四年，魏冉舉白起，使代向壽將而攻韓、魏，敗之伊闕，斬首二十四萬，虜魏將公孫喜。
units.en: In the fourteenth year of King Zhao, Wei Ran recommended Bai Qi to replace Xiang Shou as general and attack Han and Wei, defeating them at Yiguan, beheading two hundred and forty thousand, and capturing the Wei general Gongsun Xi.
units.literal: In King Zhao's fourteenth year, Wei Ran recommended Bai Qi to replace Xiang Shou as general and attack Han and Wei, defeating them at Yi Guan, beheading two hundred and forty thousand, and capturing Wei general Gongsun Xi.

units.zh: 明年，又取楚之宛、葉。
units.en: The following year, he attacked and seized Chu's Wan and Ye.
units.literal: The next year, he attacked and took Wan and Ye from Chu.

units.zh: 魏冉謝病免相，以客卿壽燭為相。
units.en: Wei Ran pleaded illness and resigned as chancellor, recommending his guest minister Shou Zhu to replace him as chancellor.
units.literal: Wei Ran claimed illness and resigned as chancellor, recommending his guest Qing Shou Zhu to replace him as chancellor.

units.zh: 其明年，燭免，復相冉，乃封魏冉於穰，復益封陶，號曰穰侯。
units.en: The following year, Zhu was dismissed and Ran became chancellor once more. Then Wei Ran was enfeoffed with Rang, his fief was further increased by Tao, and he was titled Marquis of Rang.
units.literal: The next year, Zhu was dismissed, and Ran became chancellor again. Then Wei Ran was enfeoffed with Rang, and his fief was increased by Tao, earning him the title Marquis of Rang.

units.zh: 穰侯封四歲，為秦將攻魏。
units.en: Four years after he received the title Marquis of Rang, he commanded Qin forces in an attack on Wei.
units.literal: Four years after being enfeoffed as Marquis of Rang, he served as Qin's general and attacked Wei.

units.zh: 魏獻河東方四百里。
units.en: Wei surrendered four hundred square li of land east of the Yellow River.
units.literal: Wei ceded the land east of the Yellow River, four hundred li square.

units.zh: 拔魏之河內，取城大小六十餘。
units.en: He seized Wei's territory north of the Yellow River, taking more than sixty cities, large and small.
units.literal: He seized Wei's territory north of the Yellow River, taking more than sixty cities, large and small.

units.zh: 昭王十九年，秦稱西帝，齊稱東帝。
units.en: In the nineteenth year of King Zhao, Qin styled itself Western Emperor, and Qi as Eastern Emperor.
units.literal: In King Zhao's nineteenth year, Qin honored itself as Western Emperor, and Qi as Eastern Emperor.

units.zh: 月餘，呂禮來，而齊、秦各復歸帝為王。
units.en: More than a month later, Lu Li arrived, and Qi and Qin each reverted from Emperor to King.
units.literal: More than a month later, Lu Li came, and Qi and Qin each returned to being called Wang instead of Emperor.

units.zh: 魏冉復相秦，六歲而免。
units.en: Wei Ran became chancellor of Qin once more, serving six years before being dismissed.
units.literal: Wei Ran became chancellor of Qin again, and was dismissed after six years.

units.zh: 免二歲，復相秦。
units.en: After two years' dismissal, he became chancellor of Qin once more.
units.literal: Dismissed two years, again chancellor Qin.

units.zh: 四歲，而使白起拔楚之郢，秦置南郡。
units.en: After four years, he dispatched Bai Qi to seize Chu's Ying, and Qin established the Nangun commandery.
units.literal: Four years, made Bai Qi pull Chu Ying, Qin established Nan Jun.

units.zh: 乃封白起為武安君。
units.en: Bai Qi was then enfeoffed as Lord of Wu'an.
units.literal: Then Bai Qi was enfeoffed as Lord of Wu'an.

units.zh: 白起者，穰侯之所任舉也，相善。
units.en: Bai Qi was one whom the Marquis of Rang had recommended and employed; they were on good terms.
units.literal: Bai Qi, Marquis of Rang recommended employed, mutually friendly.

units.zh: 於是穰侯之富，富於王室。
units.en: Thus, the Marquis of Rang's wealth surpassed that of the royal house.
units.literal: Then Marquis of Rang wealth, wealth exceeded royal house.

units.zh: 昭王三十二年，穰侯為相國，將兵攻魏，走芒卯，入北宅，遂圍大梁。
units.en: In the thirty-second year of King Zhao, the Marquis of Rang, serving as prime minister, led troops to attack Wei, routed Mang Mao, entered Beizhai, and thereupon besieged Daliang.
units.literal: In King Zhao's thirty-second year, the Marquis of Rang, serving as chancellor, led troops to attack Wei, routed Mang Mao, entered Bei Zhai, and then surrounded Daliang.

units.zh: 梁大夫須賈說穰侯曰：「臣聞魏之長吏謂魏王曰：『昔梁惠王伐趙，戰勝三梁，拔邯鄲；
units.en: Xu Jia, a grandee of Liang, advised the Marquis of Rang: "Your servant has heard Wei's high officials tell the King of Wei: 'Formerly King Hui of Liang attacked Zhao, won a battle at Sanliang, and captured Handan;
units.literal: Xu Jia, a grandee of Liang, advised the Marquis of Rang: Your servant has heard Wei's high officials tell the King of Wei: Formerly King Hui of Liang attacked Zhao, won a battle at Sanliang, and captured Handan;

units.zh: 趙氏不割，而邯鄲復歸。
units.en: Zhao refused to cede land, and Handan was restored to it.
units.literal: The Zhao clan did not cede land, and Handan returned to them.

units.zh: 齊人攻衛，拔故國，殺子良；
units.en: Qi attacked Wey, took its former capital, and killed Ziliang;
units.literal: Qi attacked Wei, captured Guguo, and killed Ziliang;

units.zh: 衛人不割，而故地復反。
units.en: Wey refused to cede land, and its old territory was returned.
units.literal: The people of Wei did not cede land, and the former territory was returned.

units.zh: 衛、趙之所以國全兵勁而地不并於諸侯者，以其能忍難而重出地也。
units.en: The reason Wey and Zhao survive as intact states with vigorous armies and lands not annexed by the feudal lords is that they are able to endure hardship and treat ceding territory as a grave matter.
units.literal: Wei and Zhao survive as complete states with strong troops and unannexed lands among the feudal lords because they are able to endure hardship and make heavy territorial concessions.

units.zh: 宋、中山數伐割地，而國隨以亡。
units.en: Song and Zhongshan were repeatedly attacked for ceding land, and their states perished in consequence.
units.literal: Song and Zhongshan were attacked several times for ceding land, and their states followed them into extinction.

units.zh: 臣以為衛、趙可法，而宋、中山可為戒也。
units.en: Your servant considers Wei and Zhao worthy of emulation, while Song and Zhongshan serve as cautionary examples.
units.literal: Your servant thinks Wei and Zhao can be models, while Song and Zhongshan serve as warnings.

units.zh: 秦，貪戾之國也，而毋親。
units.en: Qin is a rapacious and violent state with no kin relations.
units.literal: Qin is a greedy and violent state with no kin.

units.zh: 蠶食魏氏，又盡晉國，戰勝暴子，割八縣，地未畢入，兵復出矣。
units.en: Qin eats away at Wei like a silkworm and drains the old Jin states dry. After Baozi was defeated and eight counties were ceded, the land had not even been fully delivered before Qin sent troops out again.
units.literal: Qin nibbles away at the Wei clan and exhausts the Jin states. After defeating Baozi and obtaining the cession of eight counties, the land had not yet been fully handed over before Qin's troops came out again.

units.zh: 夫秦何厭之有哉！
units.en: How could Qin ever be satisfied!
units.literal: How could Qin ever be satisfied!

units.zh: 今又走芒卯，入北宅，此非敢攻梁也，且劫王以求多割地。
units.en: Now it has routed Mang Mao once more and entered Beizhai—this is not daring to attack Liang, but rather coercing the king to cede much land.
units.literal: Now again routed Mang Mao, entered Bei Zhai, this not dare attack Liang, moreover coerce wang seek much cede land.

units.zh: 王必勿聽也。
units.en: Your Majesty must not listen to Qin.
units.literal: Your Majesty must not listen to Qin.

units.zh: 今王背楚、趙而講秦，楚、趙怒而去王，與王爭事秦，秦必受之。
units.en: If Your Majesty now abandons Chu and Zhao to negotiate with Qin, Chu and Zhao will grow angry and desert Your Majesty, contending with you to serve Qin, and Qin will certainly accept them.
units.literal: Now wang back Chu Zhao discuss Qin, Chu Zhao angry depart wang, with wang contend serve Qin, Qin certainly accept.

units.zh: 秦挾楚、趙之兵以復攻梁，則國求無亡不可得也。
units.en: If Qin seizes Chu and Zhao's troops to attack Liang once more, then even if our state seeks to avoid destruction, it will not be possible.
units.literal: Qin grasp Chu Zhao troops again attack Liang, then state seek not perish impossible obtain.

units.zh: 願王之必無講也。
units.en: I urge Your Majesty not to negotiate under any circumstances.
units.literal: I hope Your Majesty will absolutely not negotiate.

units.zh: 王若欲講，少割而有質；
units.en: If Your Majesty does negotiate, cede only a little land and take hostages in return;
units.literal: If Your Majesty wishes to negotiate, cede little and take hostages;

units.zh: 不然，必見欺。』
units.en: If not, you will certainly be deceived.'
units.literal: not so, certainly see deceived.'

units.zh: 此臣之所聞於魏也，願君［王］之以是慮事也。
units.en: This is what your servant has heard from Wei. I wish you to consider affairs accordingly.
units.literal: Your servant has heard this from Wei and wishes you to consider affairs accordingly.

units.zh: 《周書》曰『惟命不于常』，此言幸之不可數也。
units.en: The Zhou Book says, 'The mandate does not remain constant.' This means that good fortune cannot be expected again and again.
units.literal: The Zhou Book says, 'The mandate is not constant'; this means that one cannot count on good fortune again and again.

units.zh: 夫戰勝暴子，割八縣，此非兵力之精也，又非計之工也，天幸為多矣。
units.en: The defeat of Baozi and the cession of eight counties came neither from superior military strength nor from brilliant planning; Heaven’s favor played the greater part.
units.literal: Defeating Baozi in battle and obtaining the cession of eight counties was not due to refined military strength, nor to excellent planning; Heaven's favor had much to do with it.

units.zh: 今又走芒卯，入北宅，以攻大梁，是以天幸自為常也。
units.en: Now to rout Mang Mao once more, enter Beizhai, and attack Daliang—this takes heaven's favor as a constant.
units.literal: Now to rout Mang Mao again, enter Bei Zhai, and attack Daliang - this takes Heaven's good fortune as a constant.

units.zh: 智者不然。
units.en: The wise do not act thus.
units.literal: Wise not so.

units.zh: 臣聞魏氏悉其百縣勝甲以上戍大梁，臣以為不下三十萬。
units.en: Your servant has heard that the Wei clan has mobilized the best armored troops from all its hundred counties to garrison Daliang. Your servant thinks they number not less than three hundred thousand.
units.literal: Your servant has heard that the Wei clan has mobilized all the best armored troops from its hundred counties and above to garrison Daliang. Your servant thinks they number not less than three hundred thousand.

units.zh: 以三十萬之眾守梁七仞之城，臣以為湯、武復生，不易攻也。
units.en: To defend Liang's seven-ren-high walls with three hundred thousand troops—your servant thinks that even if Tang and Wu were revived, they would not easily attack it.
units.literal: To guard Liang's seven-ren-high city with three hundred thousand troops—your servant thinks that even if Tang and Wu were revived, they would not easily attack it.

units.zh: 夫輕背楚、趙之兵，陵七仞之城，戰三十萬之眾，而志必舉之，臣以為自天地始分以至于今，未嘗有者也。
units.en: To turn lightly away from the armies of Chu and Zhao, climb walls seven ren high, fight three hundred thousand men, and insist on taking the city: your servant believes that from the first separation of Heaven and Earth down to the present, such a thing has never happened.
units.literal: To lightly turn one's back on Chu and Zhao's troops, scale seven-ren walls, battle a force of three hundred thousand, and be determined to take the city: your servant thinks that from the first division of Heaven and Earth until now, there has never been such a thing.

units.zh: 攻而不拔，秦兵必罷，陶邑必亡，則前功必棄矣。
units.en: If the attack fails to capture it, Qin troops will certainly be exhausted, Tao city will certainly perish, and then all previous merits will certainly be abandoned.
units.literal: Attack not pull, Qin troops certainly tired, Tao city certainly perish, then previous merit certainly abandon.

units.zh: 今魏氏方疑，可以少割收也。
units.en: Wei is now wavering; it can be brought over with a small concession.
units.literal: Now the Wei clan is just wavering; it can be won over with a small concession.

units.zh: 願君逮楚、趙之兵未至於梁，亟以少割收魏。
units.en: I wish my lord to hasten and make a small territorial concession to win over Wei before Chu and Zhao's troops arrive at Liang.
units.literal: I wish you to hasten and make a small concession to gather Wei before Chu and Zhao's troops arrive at Liang.

units.zh: 魏方疑而得以少割為利，必欲之，則君得所欲矣。
units.en: Since Wei is wavering, if it sees profit in a small concession, it will surely want it, and my lord will obtain what he seeks.
units.literal: Wei is just wavering, and if it can gain advantage from a small concession, it will certainly desire this; then my lord will obtain what he wishes.

units.zh: 楚、趙怒於魏之先己也，必爭事秦，從以此散，而君後擇焉。
units.en: Chu and Zhao will resent Wei for getting ahead of them and will compete to serve Qin. The alliance will break apart, and my lord can then choose among them.
units.literal: Chu and Zhao will be angry that Wei preceded them and will certainly vie to serve Qin. The alliance will thereby scatter, and my lord can afterward choose among them.

units.zh: 且君之得地豈必以兵哉！
units.en: Moreover, must my lord's acquisition of land necessarily be through troops!
units.literal: Moreover, jun obtain land how must with troops!

units.zh: 邦晉國，秦兵不攻，而魏必效絳安邑。
units.en: If you bring peace to the Jin states without sending Qin troops to attack, Wei will surely offer up Jiang and Anyi.
units.literal: If you stabilize the state of Jin without Qin troops attacking, Wei will certainly cede Jiang and Anyi.

units.zh: 又為陶開兩道，幾盡故宋，衛必效單父。
units.en: You will also open two routes to Tao and nearly exhaust the former Song lands; Wey will surely offer up Shanfu.
units.literal: You will also open two roads for Tao and nearly exhaust the former Song territories; Wei will certainly cede Shanfu.

units.zh: 秦兵可全，而君制之，何索而不得，何為而不成！
units.en: Qin troops can be preserved whole while my lord controls them—what is there to seek that cannot be obtained, what to do that cannot be accomplished!
units.literal: Qin troops can complete, jun control it, what seek not obtain, what do not complete!

units.zh: 願君熟慮之而無行危。」
units.en: I wish my lord to deliberate carefully and not pursue danger."
units.literal: Wish jun carefully consider not do danger."

units.zh: 穰侯曰：「善。」
units.en: The Marquis of Rang declared: 'Excellent.'
units.literal: Marquis of Rang said: Good.

units.zh: 乃罷梁圍。
units.en: He then lifted the siege of Liang.
units.literal: He then stopped the siege of Liang.

units.zh: 明年，魏背秦，與齊從親。
units.en: The following year, Wei betrayed Qin and formed close ties with Qi.
units.literal: Next year, Wei betrayed Qin, with Qi form close alliance.

units.zh: 秦使穰侯伐魏，斬首四萬，走魏將暴鳶，得魏三縣。
units.en: Qin dispatched the Marquis of Rang to attack Wei, beheading forty thousand, routing the Wei general Bao Yuan, and seizing three Wei counties.
units.literal: Qin made Marquis of Rang attack Wei, beheaded forty thousand, routed Wei general Bao Yuan, obtained Wei three counties.

units.zh: 穰侯益封。
units.en: The Marquis of Rang's fief was further increased.
units.literal: Marquis of Rang moreover increased enfeoff.

units.zh: 明年，穰侯與白起客卿胡陽復攻趙、韓、魏，破芒卯於華陽下，斬首十萬，取魏之卷、蔡陽、長社，趙氏觀津。
units.en: The following year, the Marquis of Rang together with Bai Qi and guest minister Hu Yang again attacked Zhao, Han, and Wei, defeating Mang Mao below Huayang, beheading one hundred thousand, and seizing Wei's Juan, Caiyang, and Changshe, as well as Zhao's Guanjin.
units.literal: Next year, Marquis of Rang with Bai Qi guest qing Hu Yang again attacked Zhao Han Wei, broke Mang Mao Hua Yang below, beheaded one hundred thousand, took Wei Juan, Cai Yang, Chang She, Zhao Guan Jin.

units.zh: 且與趙觀津，益趙以兵，伐齊。
units.en: Moreover, he returned Guanjin to Zhao, augmented Zhao with troops, and attacked Qi.
units.literal: Moreover, with Zhao Guan Jin, increased Zhao with troops, attacked Qi.

units.zh: 齊襄王懼，使蘇代為齊陰遺穰侯書曰：「臣聞往來者言曰『秦將益趙甲四萬以伐齊』，臣竊必之敝邑之王曰『秦王明而熟於計，穰侯智而習於事，必不益趙甲四萬以伐齊』。
units.en: King Xiang of Qi was alarmed, and had Su Dai secretly send the Marquis of Rang a letter on Qi's behalf: "Your servant has heard travelers say, 'Qin is going to add forty thousand armored troops to Zhao for an attack on Qi.' I privately assured the king of my humble state: 'The King of Qin sees clearly and is skilled in planning, and the Marquis of Rang is wise and practiced in affairs; they surely will not add forty thousand armored troops to Zhao to attack Qi.'
units.literal: King Xiang of Qi grew fearful and had Su Dai secretly send a letter to the Marquis of Rang on Qi's behalf: "Your servant has heard travelers say, 'Qin will add forty thousand armored troops to Zhao to attack Qi.' Your servant privately assured the king of my humble state: 'The King of Qin is clear-headed and skilled in planning, and the Marquis of Rang is intelligent and experienced in affairs; they will certainly not add forty thousand armored troops to Zhao to attack Qi.'

units.zh: 是何也？
units.en: Why is this?
units.literal: Why?

units.zh: 夫三晉之相與也，秦之深讎也。
units.en: The alliance of the Three Jin states is Qin's deepest enmity.
units.literal: San Jin mutually with, Qin deep enmity.

units.zh: 百相背也，百相欺也，不為不信，不為無行。
units.en: They turn their backs on one another a hundred times and deceive one another a hundred times, yet do not regard this as faithlessness or misconduct.
units.literal: They turn their backs on one another a hundred times and deceive one another a hundred times, but do not regard this as faithlessness or misconduct.

units.zh: 今破齊以肥趙。
units.en: Now, if Qin breaks Qi merely to fatten Zhao:
units.literal: Now to break Qi in order to enrich Zhao:

units.zh: 趙，秦之深讎，不利於秦。
units.en: Zhao is Qin's deepest enmity; this is disadvantageous to Qin.
units.literal: Zhao, Qin deep enmity, disadvantage Qin.

units.zh: 此一也。
units.en: This is the first reason.
units.literal: This one.

units.zh: 秦之謀者，必曰『破齊，獘晉、楚，而後制晉、楚之勝』。
units.en: Qin's planners will surely say, 'Break Qi, wear down Jin and Chu, and then control Jin and Chu after their victory.'
units.literal: Qin's strategists will certainly say: 'Destroy Qi, exhaust Jin and Chu, and afterward control Jin and Chu when they are victorious.'

units.zh: 夫齊，罷國也，以天下攻齊，如以千鈞之弩決潰癕也，必死，安能獘晉、楚？
units.en: Qi is already an exhausted state. For the whole world to attack Qi would be like loosing a thousand-jun crossbow at a swollen boil: Qi would certainly burst, but how would that wear down Jin and Chu?
units.literal: Qi is an exhausted state. To attack Qi with the whole world is like using a thousand-jun crossbow to burst a festering boil: Qi will certainly die, but how can this exhaust Jin and Chu?

units.zh: 此二也。
units.en: This is the second reason.
units.literal: This two.

units.zh: 秦少出兵，則晉、楚不信也；
units.en: If Qin sends few troops, then Jin and Chu will not trust us;
units.literal: Qin little send troops, then Jin Chu not trust;

units.zh: 多出兵，則晉、楚為制於秦。
units.en: If many troops are sent out, then Jin and Chu will be controlled by Qin.
units.literal: If many troops are sent, then Jin and Chu will be controlled by Qin.

units.zh: 齊恐，不走秦，必走晉、楚。
units.en: When Qi is frightened, it will not flee to Qin; it will surely flee to Jin and Chu.
units.literal: When Qi is afraid, it will not run to Qin; it will certainly run to Jin and Chu.

units.zh: 此三也。
units.en: This is the third reason.
units.literal: This three.

units.zh: 秦割齊以啖晉、楚，晉、楚案之以兵，秦反受敵。
units.en: Qin would cut up Qi as bait for Jin and Chu, while Jin and Chu pressed Qi with their armies; Qin would end up receiving enemies instead.
units.literal: Qin would carve up Qi to feed Jin and Chu, while Jin and Chu would press it with troops; Qin would instead receive enemies.

units.zh: 此四也。
units.en: This is the fourth reason.
units.literal: This four.

units.zh: 是晉、楚以秦謀齊，以齊謀秦也，何晉、楚之智而秦、齊之愚？
units.en: This would mean Jin and Chu using Qin to plot against Qi, and then using Qi to plot against Qin. Why should Jin and Chu be so clever while Qin and Qi are so foolish?
units.literal: This means Jin and Chu use Qin to plot against Qi and use Qi to plot against Qin. Why should Jin and Chu be so intelligent, and Qin and Qi so foolish?

units.zh: 此五也。
units.en: This is the fifth reason.
units.literal: This five.

units.zh: 故得安邑以善事之，亦必無患矣。
units.en: Therefore, if Qin obtains Anyi and manages the affair well, it will surely have no trouble.
units.literal: Therefore, if Qin obtains Anyi and handles matters well, there will certainly be no trouble.

units.zh: 秦有安邑，韓氏必無上黨矣。
units.en: If Qin has Anyi, the Han clan will certainly lose Shangdang.
units.literal: Qin have An Yi, Han clan certainly no Shang Dang.

units.zh: 取天下之腸胃，與出兵而懼其不反也，孰利？
units.en: Which is more advantageous: to seize the vital organs of the realm, or to send out troops and fear they may not return?
units.literal: To seize the vital organs of the world, compared with sending troops out and fearing they will not return: which is more advantageous?

units.zh: 臣故曰秦王明而熟於計，穰侯智而習於事，必不益趙甲四萬以代齊矣。」
units.en: Your servant therefore says that the King of Qin is clear-sighted and practiced in planning, and the Marquis of Rang is intelligent and experienced in affairs; they surely will not add forty thousand Qin armored troops to Zhao in order to attack Qi."
units.literal: Your servant therefore says: The King of Qin is clear-headed and skilled in planning, and the Marquis of Rang is intelligent and experienced in affairs; they will certainly not add forty thousand armored troops to Zhao to attack Qi."

units.zh: 於是穰侯不行，引兵而歸。
units.en: The Marquis of Rang then did not proceed, but led his troops back.
units.literal: The Marquis of Rang then did not go forward, but led the troops back.

units.zh: 昭王三十六年，相國穰侯言客卿灶，欲伐齊取剛、壽，以廣其陶邑。
units.en: In the thirty-sixth year of King Zhao, the chancellor Marquis of Rang recommended his guest minister Zao, desiring to attack Qi and take Gang and Shou to expand his fief at Tao.
units.literal: Zhao Wang thirty six years, chancellor Marquis of Rang spoke guest qing Zao, wished attack Qi take Gang Shou, broaden his Tao city.

units.zh: 於是魏人范睢自謂張祿先生，譏穰侯之伐齊，乃越三晉以攻齊也，以此時奸說秦昭王。
units.en: At this time the Wei man Fan Ju, calling himself Master Zhanglu, ridiculed the Marquis of Rang's attack on Qi as crossing the Three Jin to attack Qi, and craftily advised King Zhao of Qin.
units.literal: At this time the Wei man Fan Ju, calling himself Master Zhanglu, mocked the Marquis of Rang's attack on Qi as crossing the Three Jin to attack Qi, and craftily advised King Zhao of Qin.

units.zh: 昭王於是用范睢。
units.en: King Zhao thereupon employed Fan Ju.
units.literal: Zhao Wang then used Fan Ju.

units.zh: 范睢言宣太后專制，穰侯擅權於諸侯，涇陽君、高陵君之屬太侈，富於王室。
units.en: Fan Ju spoke of Empress Dowager Xuan monopolizing authority, the Marquis of Rang usurping power among the feudal lords, and the likes of Lord Jingyang and Lord Gaoling being too extravagant and wealthier than the royal house.
units.literal: Fan Ju spoke Xuan Empress Dowager monopolize power, Marquis of Rang monopolize power feudal lords, Jing Yang Jun Gao Ling Jun kind too extravagant, rich exceed wang house.

units.zh: 於是秦昭王悟，乃免相國，令涇陽之屬皆出關，就封邑。
units.en: King Zhao of Qin then understood. He dismissed the chancellor and ordered Jingyang and the others to leave the passes and go to their fiefs.
units.literal: King Zhao of Qin then understood. He dismissed the chancellor and ordered Jingyang and the others all to leave the passes and go to their fiefs.

units.zh: 穰侯出關，輜車千乘有餘。
units.en: When the Marquis of Rang left the pass, he had more than a thousand baggage wagons.
units.literal: Marquis of Rang exit pass, baggage chariots thousand ride surplus.

units.zh: 穰侯卒於陶，而因葬焉。
units.en: The Marquis of Rang died at Tao and was buried there.
units.literal: Marquis of Rang died Tao, because buried there.

units.zh: 秦復收陶為郡。
units.en: Qin reclaimed Tao as a commandery.
units.literal: Qin again collected Tao as commandery.

units.zh: 太史公曰：穰侯，昭王親舅也。
units.en: The Grand Historian remarks: The Marquis of Rang was King Zhao's own maternal uncle.
units.literal: Grand Historian said: Marquis of Rang, Zhao Wang close maternal uncle.

units.zh: 而秦所以東益地，弱諸侯，嘗稱帝於天下，天下皆西鄉稽首者，穰侯之功也。
units.en: That Qin expanded eastward, weakened the feudal lords, once styled itself emperor over all under heaven, and made all under heaven face west and bow its head was due to the Marquis of Rang's merit.
units.literal: That Qin expanded its lands eastward, weakened the feudal lords, once styled itself emperor over all under heaven, and made all under heaven face west and bow its head was due to the Marquis of Rang's merit.

units.zh: 及其貴極富溢，一夫開說，身折勢奪而以憂死，況於羈旅之臣乎！
units.en: When he reached the peak of nobility and overflowing wealth, one man's persuasion opened the way, his person was brought low and his power seized, and he died of worry. How much more vulnerable is a minister who is merely a sojourner!
units.literal: When he reached the extreme of nobility and overflowing wealth, one man's persuasion opened the way, his person was brought low and his power seized, and he died of worry; how much more so for a minister who is merely a sojourner!

units.zh: 漢則馬遷、蕭望，晉則裴楷、張華。
units.en: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.
units.literal: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.

units.zh: 伏願陛下哀忠念舊，愛孤恤寡，矜愚嘉善，舍過記功，敦骨肉之情，廣寬仁之路，思堯、舜之風，慕禹、湯之德，克己復禮，以成美化，天下幸甚。」
units.en: I venture to hope Your Majesty will pity the loyal and remember the old, cherish the orphaned and comfort the widowed, pity the foolish and praise the good, pardon faults and record merit, thicken kinship among flesh and bone, broaden the path of generous forbearance, think of the manner of Yao and Shun, admire the virtue of Yu and Tang, restrain yourself and return to ritual to complete a transformation of culture — all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."
units.literal: I venture to hope Your Majesty will pity the loyal and remember the old, cherish the orphaned and comfort the widowed, pity the foolish and praise the good, pardon faults and record merit, thicken kinship among flesh and bone, broaden the path of generous forbearance, think of the manner of Yao and Shun, admire the virtue of Yu and Tang, restrain yourself and return to ritual, to complete a transformation of culture — all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."

units.zh: 若秦因四世之勝，據河山之阻，任用白起、王翦豺狼之徒，奮其爪牙，禽獵六國，以并天下。
units.en: Qin then pursued total conquest through accumulated advantage, strategic geography, and ruthless generals.
units.literal: But Qin, relying on four generations of victories, the barrier of rivers and mountains, and employing men like Bai Qi and Wang Jian as wolfish types, exerted claws and fangs, hunting the six states to unite the realm.

units.zh: 孫、吳、商、白之徒，皆身誅戮於前，而功滅亡於後。
units.en: The lineages of Sunzi, Wuzi, Shang Yang, and Bai Qi ended in violent ruin, and their victories did not endure.
units.literal: Followers of Sun, Wu, Shang, and Bai were all themselves executed in front, and their achievements perished afterward.

units.zh: 穰侯，昭王之舅也，權重於秦，威震鄰敵，有旦莫偃伏之愛，心不介然有間，然范雎起徒步，由異國，無雅信，開一朝之說，而穰侯就封。
units.en: Marquis Rang, uncle to King Zhao of Qin, dominated that state and awed its neighbors; he shared the king's pillow and board without a shadow between them—yet Fan Ju, a stranger on foot, won a single hearing and sent Rang packing to his domain.
units.literal: Marquis Rang was King Zhao of Qin maternal uncle; his weight of power was in Qin, his awesomeness shook neighboring enemies; he had morning-and-evening couch-bending love, his mind was not stuck with a gap—yet Fan Ju rose from walking the roads, came from a different state, had no long-standing trust, opened one morning persuasion, and Marquis Rang went to his fief.

units.zh: 於是太子犯法。
units.en: Then the crown prince violated the law.
units.literal: Then the crown prince violated the law.

units.zh: 太子，君嗣也，不可施刑，刑其傅公子虔，黥其師公孫賈。
units.en: The crown prince is the ruler's heir and cannot be punished. Instead, his tutor Gongzi Qian was tattooed and his teacher Gongsun Jia was branded.
units.literal: The crown prince is the ruler heir, cannot apply punishment, punished his tutor Gongzi Qian by tattoo, branded his teacher Gongsun Jia.

units.zh: 後五月而秦孝公卒，太子立。
units.en: After five months, Duke Xiao of Qin died, and the crown prince was established as ruler.
units.literal: After five months Qin Duke Xiao died, crown prince established.

units.zh: 秦惠王車裂商君以徇，曰：「莫如商鞅反者！」
units.en: King Hui of Qin had Lord Shang's body torn apart by chariots as a warning, saying: 'Let no one be like Shang Yang in rebelling!'
units.literal: Qin Hui Wang ripped apart Lord Shang body to warn, said: "None like Lord Shang rebel!"

units.zh: 於是六國之士有甯越、徐尚、蘇秦、杜赫之屬為之謀，齊明、周聚、陳軫、邵滑、樓緩、翟景、蘇厲、樂毅之徒通其意，吳起、孫臏、帶他、兒良、王廖、田忌、廉頗、趙奢之倫制其兵。
units.en: The six states thus had men like Ning Yue, Xu Shang, Su Qin, and Du He to devise their strategies; Qi Ming, Zhou Ju, Chen Zhen, Shao Hua, Lou Huan, Di Jing, Su Li, and Yue Yi to serve as their intermediaries; and Wu Qi, Sun Bin, Dai Tuo, Ni Liang, Wang Liao, Tian Ji, Lian Po, and Zhao She to command their armies.
units.literal: Thus, the six states' scholars had Ning Yue, Xu Shang, Su Qin, and Du He and their kind to plan for them. Qi Ming, Zhou Ju, Chen Zhen, Shao Hua, Lou Huan, Di Jing, Su Li, and Yue Yi and their followers communicated their intentions. Wu Qi, Sun Bin, Dai Ta, Er Liang, Wang Liao, Tian Ji, Lian Po, and Zhao She and their sort controlled their troops.'

units.zh: 釐王三年，使公孫喜率周、魏攻秦。
units.en: In the third year of King Xi, he sent Gongsun Xi to lead the forces of Zhou and Wei in an attack on Qin.
units.literal: In Xi Wang's third year, he sent Gongsun Xi to lead Zhou and Wei in attacking Qin.

units.zh: 秦敗我二十四萬，虜喜伊闕。
units.en: Qin defeated our army of two hundred and forty thousand and captured Gongsun Xi at the Battle of Yique.
units.literal: Qin defeated our two hundred forty thousand and captured Xi at Yi Que.

units.zh: 韓厥，晉景公之三年，晉司寇屠岸賈將作亂，誅靈公之賊趙盾。
units.en: In the third year of Duke Jing of Jin, the Minister of Justice Tu'an Jia plotted to carry out a purge, intending to punish Zhao Dun for the assassination of Duke Ling.
units.literal: Han Jue, in Jin Jing Gong's third year, the Jin Si Kou Tu An Jia was about to rebel and execute Ling Gong's traitor Zhao Dun.

units.zh: 襄王四年，與秦武王會臨晉。
units.en: In the fourth year of King Xiang, he met with King Wu of Qin at Linjin.
units.literal: In Xiang Wang's fourth year, they met with Qin Wu Wang at Lin Jin.

units.zh: 秦武王卒。
units.en: King Wu of Qin died.
units.literal: Qin Wu Wang died.

units.zh: 蘇秦之在燕，與其相子之為婚，而蘇代與子之交。
units.en: While Su Qin was in Yan, he formed a marriage alliance with the prime minister Zizhi, and Su Dai formed a friendship with Zizhi.
units.literal: When Su Qin was in Yan, he formed a marriage alliance with the prime minister Zi Zhi, and Su Dai formed a friendship with Zi Zhi.

units.zh: 及蘇秦死，而齊宣王復用蘇代。
units.en: After Su Qin died, King Xuan of Qi employed Su Dai again.
units.literal: After Su Qin died, King Xuan of Qi again employed Su Dai.

units.zh: 蘇代為齊使於燕，燕王問曰：「齊王奚如？」
units.en: Su Dai served as an envoy from Qi to Yan. The Yan king asked: "What is the King of Qi like?"
units.literal: Su Dai served as envoy from Qi to Yan. The Yan king asked: "How is the King of Qi?"

units.zh: 蘇代欲以激燕王以尊子之也。
units.en: Su Dai wished to use this to encourage the Yan king to honor Zi Zhi.
units.literal: Su Dai wished to use this to stimulate the Yan king to honor Zi Zhi.

units.zh: 子之因遺蘇代百金，而聽其所使。
units.en: Zi Zhi then gave Su Dai one hundred pieces of gold and let him direct affairs as he wished.
units.literal: Zi Zhi thereupon gave Su Dai one hundred pieces of gold and followed whatever he directed.

units.zh: 對曰：「必不霸。」
units.en: He replied: "He will certainly never become hegemon."
units.literal: He replied: "He will certainly not become hegemon."

units.zh: 燕王曰：「何也？」
units.en: The Yan king asked: "Why is that?"
units.literal: The Yan king said: "Why?"

units.zh: 對曰：「不信其臣。」
units.en: He replied, “He does not trust his ministers.”
units.literal: He replied: "He does not trust his ministers."

units.zh: 揚子曰：「范雎，魏之亡命也，折脅拉髂，免於微索，翕肩蹈背，扶服入橐，激卬萬乘之主，界涇陽抵穰侯而代之，當也。
units.en: Yang Xiong replied: "Fan Ju fled Wei with a broken body, dodged the searchers, crept into a sack to reach Qin, roused the king of ten thousand chariots, blocked Lord Jingyang, and unseated the Marquis of Rang—that was exactly the right moment for such a man.
units.literal: Master Yang said: "Fan Ju was Wei’s fugitive; ribs broken and hip wrenched, he escaped fine cords; shrugging shoulder and treading back, crawling prone he entered the sack; he stirred and raised the lord of ten thousand chariots, stopped Jingyang and pressed the Marquis of Rang and replaced him—it was fitting.

units.zh: 法雄字文彊，扶風郿人也，齊襄王法章之後。
units.en: Fa Xiong, styled Wenqiang, was a native of Mei in Fufeng and traced his line to Fa Zhang, King Xiang of Qi.
units.literal: Fa Xiong, courtesy name Wenqiang, was a man of Mei in Fufeng, a descendant of Fa Zhang, King Xiang of Qi.

units.zh: 昭王三十四年，白起攻魏，拔華陽，走芒卯，而虜三晉將，斬首十三萬。
units.en: In King Zhao's thirty-fourth year, Bai Qi attacked Wei, conquered Huayang, routed Mang Mao, captured three Jin generals, and beheaded 130,000 men.
units.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of King Zhao, Bai Qi attacked Wei, conquered Huayang, routed Mang Mao, captured three Jin generals, and beheaded 130,000 men.

units.zh: 蘇代又謂秦太后弟羋戎曰：「公叔伯嬰恐秦楚之內蟣蝨也，公何不為韓求質子於楚？
units.en: Su Dai then said to Mi Rong, the brother of the Queen Mother of Qin, "Gongshu Boying fears that Qin and Chu will install Ji Shi. Why do you not seek a hostage from Chu on Han's behalf?
units.literal: Su Dai again told Qin queen mother younger brother Mi Yong said: 'Gong Shu Bo Ying fear Qin Chu take in Jiu Jie, duke why not for Han seek hostage from Chu?

units.zh: 其後，秦亡將呂禮相齊，欲困蘇代。
units.en: Afterward, Lu Li, a general who had fled Qin, became chancellor of Qi and wanted to put pressure on Su Dai.
units.literal: After, Qin perished general Lu Li chancellor Qi, wish distress Su Dai.

units.zh: 於是孟嘗君從其計，而呂禮嫉害於孟嘗君。
units.en: Lord Mengchang then followed his plan, but Lü Li grew jealous and acted against him.
units.literal: Lord Mengchang then followed his plan, but Lü Li grew jealous and harmed Lord Mengchang.

units.zh: 若齊不破，呂禮復用，子必大窮。」
units.en: If Qi is not broken and Lü Li is employed again, you will certainly be greatly impoverished.'
units.literal: If Qi not break, Lu Li again use, you certainly great poor."

units.zh: 於是穰侯言於秦昭王伐齊，而呂禮亡。
units.en: Marquis Rang then spoke to King Zhao of Qin about attacking Qi, and Lü Li fled.
units.literal: Marquis Rang then spoke to King Zhao of Qin to attack Qi, and Lü Li fled.

units.zh: 齊秦相取以臨三晉，呂禮必并相矣，是子通齊以重呂禮也。
units.en: If Qi and Qin join forces against the Three Jin, Lu Li will surely hold chancellorships in both states. In that case, you will have connected Qin with Qi only to make Lu Li important.
units.literal: Qi Qin mutually take face three Jin, Lu Li certainly together chancellor, is you through Qi heavy Lu Li.

units.zh: 齊、秦合，則親弗與呂禮重矣。
units.en: If Qi and Qin unite, then Qin Fu and Lu Li will become important.
units.literal: Qi Qin unite, then close Fu with Lu Li heavy.

units.zh: 周嘗為蒙漆園吏，與梁惠王、齊宣王同時。
units.en: Zhou once served as an official in Meng's lacquer garden, and was contemporary with Liang King Hui and Qi King Xuan.
units.literal: Zhou once was Meng lacquer garden official, contemporary with Liang Hui King and Qi Xuan King.
